haikus.haiku:
Orange sun glows bright
Citrus mist lifts the glass high
Taste of sunshine swirls
Happy #NationalHarveyWallbangerDay from @ClamBakeSanta

haikus.theme: Cook Something Bold and Pungent Day
haikus.haiku:
Spice sparks in pan now
Red peppers sing bold heat bright
Flavor dances loud
Happy #CookSomethingBoldAndPungentDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright candles flicker
Ink swirls like sunrise soft glow
Joy pours in each print
#HappyBirthdayHermannRorschach from @ClamBakeSanta
